681	above reason and knowledge.
682	That is what makes him a tzaddik, not only the aspect of influence.
683	How much he influences someone else, what he is capable of.
684	The very fact that he makes this movement, which is above reason and knowledge, will surely also influence others, but
685	the movement is first of all in him, in his inner point.
686	Certainly.
687	"Influencer," when we say influencer, does not mean in the external sense, like social media influencers
688	or any such types.
689	An influencer is not someone who influences another to do what he wants.
690	An influencer is on the way to being a tzaddik.
691	That is called a tzaddik, an influencer is called a tzaddik.
692	An influencer is a person who walks in the way of bestowal toward others.
693	That is what is called an influencer.
694	He does good to others, he gives of himself.
695	That is called a person who bestows.
696	As if it is...
697	It may be that he will not be in that state, if he is in an environment that is very bad,
698	hostile, even criminal, and there he makes some very great movement outward.
699	But he did influence through the movement itself, because he...
700	Suddenly, the fact that he makes a movement within himself will surely also create
701	a movement in that environment.
702	They will not follow him, but it creates something, because it is a resonance that we created.
703	You are right.
704	They tell that Baal HaSulam sat in the beit midrash and learned Torah, and the whole war, I think
705	it was the war of '48, the War of Independence, the whole War of Independence
706	moved according to Baal HaSulam's Torah learning.
707	He described there what he was learning, and he directed things to happen in this way and that way.
708	So we see from this example that a tzaddik sits and learns Torah and influences the whole world.
709	It need not be specifically through direct contact or contact of one kind or another. We also see that things are learned, for example, in our beit
710	midrash, which are spoken about in other places that had no direct
711	connection to us. They speak in our language. The concept of "together," which I think the Rav
712	has been speaking about for many years. See how it entered the people of Israel as a concept
713	of "together we will win," and the whole use of this concept "together," and even a political party, it seems, is called
714	"Together." The concept "together" is a concept that took root relatively recently, as I see it,
715	while in Sulam they have been speaking about it for many years. So the concepts that are spoken about, the Torah of the tzaddikim,
716	is a Torah that takes up volume and expansion even without their being present in every
717	single place.
